title: Inside the Experimental Traps Scientists Set for Ghostly Neutrinos
summary: Here we see the traces of a muon neutrino (left) and an electron neutrino (right), two of the fundamental particles in the Standard Model of particle physics. Above, a researcher checks a photomultiplier tube, which amplifies light created by neutrino interactions.
